text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew... Haaaah...!!

Vivlos achieved a brilliant result
in the Nakayama Kinen. It was a magnificent run
that will surely hold up in Dubai as well...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...
Haaah...
Right after the race, Vivlos slumped down and couldn't move for quite a while.

"Seeing just how fiercely exhausted she was,
there was only one decision left to make."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really not okay...?
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I can't let you.

text_block_list.text:
As the doctor at the hospital explained,
an overseas expedition is extremely harsh.
It would place a heavy burden on Vivlos in her current condition.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Though, maybe...
it's actually completely fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: There's also a chance that the overseas environment might suit her better.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!
Then—
choice_data_list: Still, please indulge my selfishness just this once.
Still, please indulge my selfishness this time.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Rather than gamble on a possibility, I want to take care of you.
Rather than gamble on a possibility, I want to cherish you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Being that kind
isn't being selfish at all."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Truth is, deep down I already know.
Like, 'Ah, I have to give up on this...'

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I knew it,
having it all... really is impossible, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...The things you truly want
are always so far out of reach."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos,
good work today."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...You know, I—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Vivlos.
...I can tell just by looking at your face."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...As expected of Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay,
Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Just think about it!
Dubai isn't going anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Just focus on healing up properly
and aim for next year. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right on!
Yeah...
choice_data_list: ...We gotta come up with an alternative goal!
...We'll have to think of another goal!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right!
I wonder what would be good~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is it...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
I just had a great idea♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: How about the Victoria Mile?
As the name suggests, the Victoria Mile is a 1600m mile GⅠ race. It has two main characteristics: strong performances by Tiara route competitors, and――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's the race Big Sister won back-to-back, after all!
I want to run in it too!

Having produced results at the same 1600m in the Oka Sho, she has made her presence known along the Tiara route.
Above all, she is motivated. If so, then...
choice_data_list: Shall we move on to the "Victoria Mile"?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it, Big Sis.
I'll definitely make it exciting for you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Excited...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, if I win too,
wouldn't that be super amazing?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to show you me running in Dubai, but... just like on the Tiara route, I'll make you smile again♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...She did her best,
all for my sake."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I have to say thank you.
As the big sister... that she loves so much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —For my own sake, as well.

Our next target race is the Victoria Mile.
Putting off Dubai until next year, Vivlos's new domestic challenge begins.
